page_note: Highly substratic page detailing the cosmogonic begetting of Adam and Eve and the three moldings (plasmata). The teaching describes how the powers, seeing the desire-arousing image, mingled and produced a "new birth" likened to the icon revealed in the cosmos. Then transitions to a numbered enumeration of moldings not produced through intercourse — the first molded by fire and enthumesis from the sea, the second falling on the earth. Pure cosmological-correspondential teaching with no apostolic frame, no ecclesial overlay, no polemic. The single ecclesial flag at i=15 is a false positive from the vocabulary counter (likely the word "birth"/"begat" — context is cosmogonic, not institutional). Heavy lacunae but the surviving teaching voice is consistently impersonal-systemic.
